rows.name: fallbackMessage
rows.description: The fallback message to be displayed if no tabs are available.

rows.name: size
rows.description: The size of the tabs. Can be "small" or "large". The default value is small

rows.name: variant
rows.description: The variant of the tabs. Can be "hug" or "fill". The default value is fill

rows.name: divider
rows.description: Whether to display a divider between the tabs and the content.
